name: Machine Vision Inspection — Application Concept
shortDescription: An example workflow for automated presence, orientation, and surface checks on a production line.
description: Illustrative sample only. This concept shows how a vision inspection station could fit into a production workflow; it is not a completed FEINCORE customer installation.
imageAlt: Illustrative industrial machine vision inspection station
challenge: Manual checks can be inconsistent when part presentation varies or line speed increases.
approach: Define inspection criteria, evaluate camera and lighting options, and plan how inspection results would communicate with machine controls.
solution: A proposed camera station could capture each part, evaluate defined features, and return a pass/fail signal to the line. Feasibility and performance require application testing.

seo.title: Machine Vision Inspection Application Concept | FEINCORE
seo.description: Illustrative sample machine vision inspection workflow, not a completed customer project.

name: Robotic Machine Tending — Application Concept
shortDescription: A sample robotic loading workflow for moving parts between an operator area and a machine.
description: Illustrative sample only. This example outlines a possible machine-tending cell and does not represent a deployed FEINCORE system.
imageAlt: Illustrative robotic arm in a manufacturing workspace
challenge: Repeated loading and unloading can occupy operator time and require consistent part handling.
approach: Review part presentation, machine cycle timing, reach, end-of-arm tooling, guarding, and safe operator access before selecting a robot.
solution: A potential robot cell could transfer fixtures or parts between a staging position and machine interface, with interlocks and recovery procedures defined during engineering.

seo.title: Robotic Machine Tending Concept | FEINCORE
seo.description: Illustrative robotic machine-tending workflow concept, not a completed customer project.

name: Legacy Machine Modernization — Application Concept
shortDescription: A sample assessment and retrofit plan for updating an existing machine control and monitoring workflow.
description: Illustrative sample only. Actual retrofit feasibility depends on equipment condition, safety requirements, documentation, and commercial evaluation.
imageAlt: Illustrative machine modernization and control station
challenge: An older machine may lack current operator feedback, maintainable controls, or useful production data.
approach: Document the existing system, inspect electrical and mechanical condition, identify safety gaps, and prioritize upgrades with the equipment owner.
solution: A scoped modernization could update selected controls, operator screens, sensors, and data capture while retaining suitable machine hardware where feasible.

seo.title: Machine Modernization Concept | FEINCORE
seo.description: Illustrative industrial machine modernization approach, not a completed customer project.
